description: The TRANSCRIPT METADATA block both prompts carry, and the one line in it that says what the statement date is and how it is known. predictions_lib.speaker_header renders it with str.format; a missing field raises. POLICY_RELEASE.json pins this file's sha256 as contracts.header, so a wording change needs a new release. The labels in brackets are the ones EXTRACTION.md section 1a tells the extractor to read.

date_lines.stated_in_page: Statement date: {date} (stated in the source itself; this is when the words were written or spoken.)
date_lines.publication_date: Statement date: no later than {date} (publication date, NOT checked against the event. The words may have been spoken earlier; see section 1a of the specification.)
date_lines.youtube_upload_date: Statement date: no later than {date} (YouTube upload date, NOT checked against the event. The recording may be years older; see section 1a of the specification.)
date_lines.unknown: Statement date: unknown (no date for this recording could be established.)
date_lines.override_day: Statement date: {date} (the day the words were spoken, from a sourced correction: {basis}. {own_sentence})
date_lines.override_published: Statement date: {date} (the recording was published on this date, from a sourced correction: {basis}. The words were spoken on this date or before it. {own_sentence})
date_lines.override_range: Statement date: {date} (the latest day the words could have been spoken, from a sourced correction: {basis}. They were spoken between {earliest} and {date}. {own_sentence})
date_lines.override_range_unsourced: Statement date: {date} (the latest day the words could have been spoken, from a sourced correction: {basis}. The first possible day, {earliest}, is the dating agent's estimate, and no source confirms it. {own_sentence})
date_lines.own_later: The {own_label}, {own_date}, is later and is NOT when the words were said.
date_lines.own_none: The source carries no date of its own.
date_lines.check_day: Statement date: {date} ({own_label}. A dating check found the words were spoken on this date: {basis}.)
date_lines.check_published: Statement date: {date} ({own_label}. A dating check found the recording was published on this date: {basis}. The words were spoken on this date or before it.)
date_lines.check_sourced: Statement date: {date} ({own_label}. A dating check found no earlier event: {basis}. The words were spoken on this date or up to {days} days before it.)
date_lines.check_unsourced: Statement date: {date} ({own_label}. A dating check found no earlier event: {basis}. This date is an upper bound; that the words were spoken no earlier than {earliest} is the dating agent's estimate, and no source confirms it.)
